sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
கற்சிலை என்றாலும் உளம் குளிரும்
பொற்சிலை நீயல்லவோ தாயே
sections.translit:
kaRchilai endRAlum uLam kuLirum
poRchilai nIyallavO thAyE
sections.en: Even if you are just a stone statue standing here, Mother, are you not the golden idol that leaves a devotee’s heart cool and satisfied?

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.en: Oh Goddess, is it not apt to address you as Santha Durgai when looking at your image?

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
சுந்தர வடிவமும் சினம் தணிந்த விழிகளும்
அந்தரர் போற்றும் மாண்பும் அன்பர்க்கருள்
கரகமலமும் கலியின் வலியால் நலியும் ஜீவனின்
கருவாசம் நீக்கிடும் தாய்மனமும் ஒருசேரும் திருவே
sections.translit:
sundhara vadivamum sinam thaNindha vizhigaLum
andharar pOtRum mANbum anbarkkaruL
karakamalamum kaliyin valiyAl naliyum jIvanin
karuvAsam nIkkidum thAymanamum orusErum thiruvE
sections.en: You are  the definition of charm, eyes devoid of even a trace of anger, greatness that even celestials worship, soft lotus hands that offer blessings to devotees, mother’s instincts that (out of infinite compassion) clear the birth cycle of devotees suffering the torture of Kaliyuga.

notes: This song is an appreciation of the beauty of Shantha Durga Devi in the temple located 33 kilometers from Panajim, Goa. This is an exquisite temple with a beautiful idol of Durga Devi who mediated between Vishnu and Siva in their fierce war and stopped it per the temple legend. Devi’s idol is flanked on either side by tiny images of Siva and Vishnu. The anupallavi of this song and the charanam line “அந்தரர் போற்றும் மாண்பும் (andharar potRum mANbum)” allude to this peace negotiation.
